steps.name: 시험 시트 zsheetmerge 만들기(PUT - 새 문서)
다른 셀 - 내 입력(A2) + 다른 창(B1) → 둘 다 남고 '합쳐 저장' 알림(충돌 배너 없음)
steps.js: { const td=document.querySelector('td[data-r="1"][data-c="0"]'); td.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown",{bubbles:true,button:0})); window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mouseup")); const ed=document.querySelector("#editor"); ed.value="내 값"; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Enter",bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); } { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const c=d.sheets[0].cells; ((c)=>{ c.B1='밖'; })(c); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } await until(async () => (document.querySelector('#toast').classList.contains('show') && document.querySelector('#toast').textContent.includes("합쳐")), 8000); await until(async () => (((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).A2==='내 값'), 8000); const c=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells; return c.A2==='내 값' && c.B1==='밖' && !document.querySelector('#banner.show') ? true : JSON.stringify({c, t:document.querySelector('#toast').textContent});

steps.name: Ctrl+Z - 내 입력만 되돌리고 다른 창의 B1 은 남는다
steps.js: document.querySelector("#editor").focus(); document.querySelector("#editor").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"z",ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await until(async () => (((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).A2===undefined), 8000); const c=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells; return c.A2===undefined && c.B1==='밖' && c.A1==='하나' ? true : JSON.stringify(c);

steps.name: 같은 셀(A1)을 동시에 - 나중 저장(내 값)이 남고 '같은 곳 1건' 알림
steps.js: await until(async () => (!window.NexaSheet.S.dirty && !window.NexaSheet.S.saving && document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'), 8000); { const td=document.querySelector('td[data-r="0"][data-c="0"]'); td.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mousedown",{bubbles:true,button:0})); window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent("mouseup")); const ed=document.querySelector("#editor"); ed.value="안"; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Enter",bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); } { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const c=d.sheets[0].cells; ((c)=>{ c.A1='밖'; })(c); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } await until(async () => (document.querySelector('#toast').classList.contains('show') && document.querySelector('#toast').textContent.includes("1건")), 8000); await until(async () => (((await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells).A1==='안'), 8000); const c=(await (await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).sheets[0].cells; const t=document.querySelector('#toast').textContent; return c.A1==='안' && t.includes('1건') && t.includes('내 값') ? true : JSON.stringify({c, t});

steps.name: 편집하지 않을 때 밖의 변경 → 그대로 다시 읽기
steps.js: await until(async () => (!window.NexaSheet.S.dirty && !window.NexaSheet.S.saving && document.querySelector('#status').textContent==='저장됨'), 8000); { const r=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge',{cache:'no-store'}); const v=r.headers.get('X-Deck-Version'); const d=await r.json(); const c=d.sheets[0].cells; ((c)=>{ c.B1='다시'; })(c); const p=await fetch('/api/deck/zsheetmerge?base='+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:'PUT',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','X-Nexa-Tab':'other-window'},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); if(!p.ok) return 'external put '+p.status; } await until(async () => (window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells.B1==='다시'), 8000); const c=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells; return c.B1==='다시' && c.A1==='안' && !window.NexaSheet.S.dirty ? true : JSON.stringify(c);
